input.title: Fix header handling with quoted column names
input.body:
File: src/ingest/parser.ts

The `parseStatement` function currently does not correctly handle the header line when column names are double-quoted. The split operation on the header should take quotes into account similarly to how transaction lines are handled.

text:
The issue is a bug in handling quoted column names in the first line of CSV files. The `parseStatement` function in `src/ingest/parser.ts` does not properly handle headers with quoted column names because it splits the header on commas without considering quotes, leading to a mismatch between header and row columns.

labels: [bug]
file: src/ingest/parser.ts

I'll proceed with opening a draft pull request and posting a comment with this information.
